home.aboutTitle: There’s a story beyond the profile.

features.title: Their own tastes. Their own stories.
features.body: Different personalities, backgrounds, and favorite things. Read the profiles and find a persona you'd like to know better.

features.title: Somewhere you already feel at home
features.body: No separate messaging app to install. Share a little of your day in the iMessage you already use.

features.title: Another chapter in your conversation
features.body: Conversations that build on what you've shared. From everyday moments to favorite things, get to know each other over time.

home.howTitle: It starts with a little curiosity.

steps.title: Have a look
steps.body: Choose an image style, then explore the personas' photos and introductions.

steps.title: Show your interest
steps.body: Like the personas you're curious about. It's fine to choose more than one.

steps.title: A persona will reach out
steps.body: Register your iPhone number for iMessage and give consent. If selected, one of your liked personas will reach out first.

home.selectionNote: Selection isn't first-come, first-served, and there is no set contact time. Registration doesn't guarantee an immediate connection.
home.faqTitle: A few things you might be wondering.

questions.title: Am I talking to a real person?
questions.body: No. Ren AI personas are fictional people played by AI. Their photos and profiles represent fictional people, too. This isn't a service for connecting with real people.

questions.title: Do I need another app?
questions.body: No separate messaging app is needed. You need an iPhone with iMessage and a mobile number. Android isn't supported yet.

questions.title: Will I hear from someone right away?
questions.body: We're currently accepting waitlist registrations. Selected visitors receive a message; selection isn't first-come, first-served, and contact timing isn't fixed.

questions.title: Will I talk to everyone I like?
questions.body: You'll start with one available persona from your Likes. Liking a persona doesn't guarantee a connection with that particular persona.

questions.title: What information do I register?
questions.body: Your iPhone number for iMessage and preferred conversation language. Name, age, and gender are optional. Read the privacy information and give consent to complete your waitlist registration.

home.closingBody: Start with a profile. Take your time.
home.footer: Everyday moments with AI personas. Ren AI.
